text:
alana: Quick sync: we need a minimal migration guide for v1->v2 aimed at integrators (one-pager + examples). Goal: publish banner + migration page by 2025-05-30 morning.
mike: I'll draft the code snippets (py/ts). Key callout: `client.models.invoke` -> `client.responses.create` and input shape change. Keep side-by-side examples.
sam: I'll own PR template and link-checker workflow. Will add labels: docs-deprecate, needs-smoke.
ciara: I'll do the model mapping section and a short paragraph about embedding dimension changes and reindex advice.
docs-bot: automation note: add redirects for /v1/* -> new pages or banner; we can run a redirect generator once mapping is final.
alana: Also include a tiny compat shim example and mark it temporary. Something like: `def invoke_v1_shim(c,m,input): return c.responses.create(model=m, input=[{"role":"user","content":input}])`.
mike: I'll add streaming snippet update too (event rename: `chunk` -> `response.delta`). Will run smoke tests in staging.
sam: PR checklist in template: summary, files touched, smoke test link, redirects list, reviewer. I'll open the template PR today.
alana: Perfect. Post PR links here when ready and I'll assemble a playbook page that links all pieces. :eyes:
